name: hashdeep
description: Digital forensics hashing suite with MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, Tiger, and Whirlpool support

tools.description: Recursive file hashing tool for digital forensics and integrity verification
tools.usage:
hashdeep -r /path/to/investigate # Recursive hashing
hashdeep -c baseline.txt # Compare against baseline
hashdeep -a -e -s *.exe # Audit mode with estimates
hashdeep -m known_hashes.txt suspect_files/ # Match against known hashes

tools.description: 64-bit version of hashdeep for large file operations and improved performance
tools.usage: hashdeep64 -r -s /large/dataset # Hash large datasets\nhashdeep64 -j 8 -r /path # Use 8 threads for parallel processing\nhashdeep64 -W audit.txt # Whirlpool hashing audit

tools.description: Specialized MD5 hash calculator for forensic analysis and file verification
tools.usage: md5deep -r /evidence # Recursive MD5 hashing\nmd5deep -m known_md5.txt *.bin # Match against known MD5s\nmd5deep -x known_bad.txt /suspect # Exclude known bad hashes

tools.description: 64-bit MD5 hash calculator for large-scale forensic analysis and file verification
tools.usage:
md5deep64 -r /large/evidence # Hash large evidence directories
md5deep64 -j 16 /parallel # Use 16 threads
md5deep64 -m baseline.md5 /check # Verify against baseline

tools.description: SHA-1 hash calculator for legacy forensic analysis and file integrity verification
tools.usage:
sha1deep -r /evidence # Recursive SHA-1 hashing
sha1deep -m known.sha1 *.bin # Match against known hashes
sha1deep -a -e /audit # Audit with size estimates

tools.description: 64-bit SHA-1 hash calculator for large-scale legacy forensic operations
tools.usage:
sha1deep64 -r -j 8 /large/dataset # Multi-threaded hashing
sha1deep64 -m baseline.sha1 /verify # Verify integrity

tools.description: SHA-256 hash calculator for modern cryptographic file verification
tools.usage: sha256deep -r /secure/files # Recursive SHA-256 hashing\nsha256deep -m hashes.sha256 /download # Verify downloads\nsha256deep -a -e /forensics # Audit with size estimates

tools.description: 64-bit SHA-256 hash calculator for high-performance cryptographic verification
tools.usage:
sha256deep64 -r -j 16 /enterprise # High-performance hashing
sha256deep64 -m checksums.sha256 /verify # Bulk verification

tools.description: Tiger hash algorithm calculator for fast cryptographic hashing and file verification
tools.usage:
tigerdeep -r /files # Recursive Tiger hashing
tigerdeep -m baseline.tiger *.bin # Match verification
tigerdeep -a -e /audit # Audit mode with estimates

tools.description: 64-bit Tiger hash calculator for high-speed cryptographic operations on large datasets
tools.usage:
tigerdeep64 -r -j 12 /large/files # Multi-threaded Tiger hashing
tigerdeep64 -m hashes.tiger /verify # Verification

tools.description: Whirlpool hash algorithm calculator for advanced cryptographic hashing and integrity verification
tools.usage:
whirlpooldeep -r /secure # Recursive Whirlpool hashing
whirlpooldeep -m baseline.whirlpool *.exe # Verification
whirlpooldeep -a -e /forensics # Audit mode

tools.description: 64-bit Whirlpool hash calculator for enterprise-grade cryptographic operations
tools.usage:
whirlpooldeep64 -r -j 16 /enterprise # High-performance Whirlpool hashing
whirlpooldeep64 -m checksums.whirlpool /verify # Bulk verification
